Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh have got a handy lead on a rank turner and they would look to swell it somewhere close to 250. Anything near that or above it, could very well take them close to victory. Can they? Or will we see an inspirational bowling display from the Aussies? Join us shortly to find out what happens next...

So Bangladesh have finally managed to wrap things up. Shakib Al Hasan was the best of the lot as the all-rounder once again displayed a classical performance, picking up a 5-fer. They could have had done that early but it wasn't meant to be. After Renshaw and Handscomb did the steadying job with their 69-run stand, Cummins and Agar then frustrated the hosts by digging it out there. In the process they stitched another crucial 49-run stand which helped them reduce the deficit under 50 in the end.

OUT! 16th Test 5-fer for Shakib Al Hasan! He tosses it up around middle and off, it bounces a touch as Hazlewood comes forward to defend. Gets an inside edge and Kayes at forward short leg accepts the catch gleefully. Shakib now has a fabulous record under his belt - he now has a 5-fer against all nine Test playing nations and is the quickest to do so amongst Hearth, Steyn and Muralitharan. That's some feat. Well done, lad. It's all over for Australia. THEY ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 217, TRAILING BY 43 RUNS!
Agar lunges forward and eases it down to long off for a single.
Flighted on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Quicker one around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
On the pads, clipped away towards mid-wicket. Call is for two but the fielder is quick to deny them the second.

FOUR! Brilliant, just brilliant! No one would believe that a tailender has played a shot like this. Mind boggling stuff! Mehedi tosses it up outside off, Ashton Agar skips down the track and lifts it inside out over extra cover to pick up a boundary. He's adding valuable runs for his side.
Loopy delivery outside off, Agar blocks it out.
Quicker but a bit too full outside off, Ashton prods forward in defense.
Fired around middle and leg, flicked towards mid on for a single.
Goes back and works it with the spin towards mid-wicket. Deficit is now cut down to 50!
Good-looking drive! Full and served pretty wide outside off, Josh makes room and drives it through covers. The fielder gives it a chase and does well to stop a run for his side.
Slider from around the wicket, Hazlewood lunges forward to defend but the ball straightens to beat the outside edge.
Slower on off, flicked through mid on for one.
Darts it around middle and leg, Hazlewood clips it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Comes down the track and milks a single down to long off for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shimmies down a touch and lofts it over mid off for one.
Agar gets behind the line and shows a straight bat.

A loud shout for an LBW! Tossed up outside off, it grips in as Agar gets down to play the slog sweep. He misses as the ball goes off his left shoulder. They all appeal but the height seems to be an issue there.
Fires it flat and outside off, Ashton shoulders his arms to that one.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven into the cover region.
Comes a touch forward and eases it towards mid off.
Gives it a nice loop outside off, defended into the ground.
Flattish outside off, Agar punches it back to the bowler who fumbles as the ball parries towards long off for a single.
Allows the ball to turn in and then works it towards the leg side.
FOUR! What a shot! Shakib floats it up wider outside off, Agar crouches low, makes room and drills it through extra cover to bring up 200 for his side.
Good running! A bit too full on middle and off, Agar drills it straight back past the bowler towards long on and comes back for a brace.
Full outside off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
Darted around off, Hazlewood blocks it out.
Makes a bit of room and drives it towards cover.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Agar somehow flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Sliding in on middle, Ashton flicks it wide of mid on. The fielder fumbles in the chase which allows the pair to come back for a double.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. A wicket maiden from Shakib.
Covers the line and offers a solid defense.
Flatter ball from over the wicket, Josh is firm in his defense.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.

OUT! Shakib Al Hasan once again provides the breakthrough. He tosses it up outside off, it skids in a touch. Cummins looks to drive it away from the body but does with hard hands. Gets an inside edge on the back pad as the ball then rolls onto the stumps. Shakib has his left arm aloft. Bangladesh once again strike immediately after the break. Can the all-rounder pick up a 5-fer?
Loopy ball around off, once again it's kept out off the front foot.
From around the wicket, Shakib floats it up on off, Cummins nicely lunges forward to defend it down.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Agar tries to defend it but gets beaten all ends up.
Spinning into the pads, Agar gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.
Floated outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Shorter around off, pushed back to the bowler off the back foot.
Quicker around leg, defended on the leg side.
Floated around off, Ashton Agar stays in his crease and defends it towards point.
The players are making their way out in the middle. It shall be Ashton Agar to face Mehedi Hasan first up. Let's play...
UPDATE 1508 local - We have great news. The covers are off and it has all cleared up. Good that it was just a passing shower.
UPDATE 1504 local - We should have started the final session of the day by now but seems like the dark clouds have opened up. A bit of a delay here...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Australia will be hoping that these two can continue for as long as possible. The hosts on the other hand have been brilliant with the ball but they are still paying the price of a dropped catch of Cummins by Shafiul Islam. The final session of the day could turn the game in anyone's favour. Join us in a short while for it.

A sedentary passage of play and Australia will be a lot happier. After picking up Maxwell and Wade early after Lunch, Bangladesh would have hoped to finish off the proceedings quickly. But, Cummins and Agar had different plans altogether as they survived some scares and stitched a vital unbeaten stand of 49 runs, reducing the deficit to 67 runs.
Flatter around leg, Agar clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket for a single. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2!
Floated around off, Agar gets in line of the ball to defend.
Around middle and leg, AA gets forward to defend.
Tossed up around off, Ashton prods forward and defends it neatly.
Quicker around leg, Agar tries to defend it. Gets it off the inner half through the short fine leg region for a couple.
Floated outside off, Agar prods forward and defends it.
Nasir Hossain has been finally handed the ball.
Angling into the batsman, Cummins defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Another short delivery and Ashton half pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Agar goes for the pull. Gets it towards mid-wicket along the ground and the fielder there deflects it towards the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery around off, pushed through the point region for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Cummins stands tall and fends it away.
Length delivery outside off, Cummins drives it towards the fielder at covers.

SIX! Kaboom! Floated outside off, Agar kneels down, gets in the perfect position. Slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. Ashton is making the most of it here and he along with Cummins has added 44 runs for the 9th wicket already.
Drifting into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Agar defends it well.
Fuller into the pads, clipped towards the fielder at mid on.
Shorter around off, Ashton stays deep in his crease to defend.
Floated outside off, Agar shoulders his arms to it.
Cummins gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

NOT OUT! Cummins survives! Hurls this down the leg side, Cummins shuffles across and tries to clip it fine. Hits something on its way to the keeper. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Pat is quick to opt for the review as he is confident that it came off the thigh pad. Indicates so and replays reflect the same. There was no bat involved there. Aleem Dar is having a day to forget as an umpire.
Pat Cummins is adjudged caught behind! But he is confident that it went off his thigh pad and hence takes the review.
Good length delivery outside off, Cummins raises his bat skywards.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Cummins lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Cummins shoulders his arms to it.
Angles it into the pads, Agar clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shafiul Islam is brought in for a bowl.
Sprayed down the leg side, Cummins fails to clip it through.
Just short! Spinning in from around off, Cummins stays in his crease and defends it just in front of the fielder at FSL.
Shorter outside off, Pat stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller around leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
The batsman offers no stroke and is wrapped on the pads.
Floated outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Gives it some air and drops it fuller around leg, Cummins waits for it and blocks it away.
Fuller into the pads, Pat clips it on the leg side.
Tossed up around middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
Drifting down the leg side, Cummins fails to clip it through.
Floated around off, driven towards the fielder at mid on for a single.
Short delivery outside off, stays low. Agar still manages to whip it on the leg side.
Pat defends it neatly off the back foot.
FOUR! Deft! Quicker down the leg side, Cummins works it really fine past the keeper for a boundary. Pat is doing the bulk of the scoring here.
Just fell short! Tossed up around leg, Cummins clips it uppishly on the leg side. Just falls short of the diving forward fielder at mid-wicket.

Comes around the wicket, bowls it in line of the stumps. Cummins gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
The dark clouds are hovering over the stadium. Seems like they can burst out any moment...
Mehedi Hasan is back for a bowl.
Floated in line of the stumps, Cummins drives it towards the fielder at mid off for a single.
Around leg this time, Cummins reads the turn and defends it.

Sprayed down the leg side, Cummins pads it away.
Down the leg side, Cummins does not offer a stroke to it.

Angling into the hips, Cummins stays in his crease and clips it through the backward square leg region for a couple. The batsmen hesitate a bit in the middle but a bad throw by the fielder helps their cause.
Length delivery around off, Cummins stays in his crease and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Ashton gets forward and defends the ball around off neatly.
Shorter outside off, pushed towards covers off the crease.

Pat lunges forward, gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.
Floated around off, Cummins prods forward and defends it.

Fuller and angling it in from outside off, Cummins opens the bat face and dabs it wide of the gully fielder for a single.
Fullish in length outside off, Pat jams it out towards cover.
Angles it in on the pads, it comes slowly off the deck as Cummins looks to work it away. Misses and gets hit on the pads. Rahman appeals but nothing from the umpire. Going down leg.
Cutter outside off, Cummins leans across and drives it square of the wicket towards the off side.
Rahman sprays it fuller and wider outside off, Cummins reaches out to that one and he drives it through covers for a brace.
Quicker around off, Agar prods forward in defence. Gets it towards point off the outer half.
Agar reaches to the pitch of the ball and defends it.

Agar stays behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Good length delivery outside off, Pat raises his bat skywards.
Length delivery around off, Cummins lunges forward and defends it towards point.
Fires this way outside off, Cummins shoulders his arms to it.

Mustafizur Rahman is back for a bowl.
Time for Drinks...

In the air... dropped. Shakib Al Hasan is absolutely fumed by this effort. He lands it around middle, Cummins looks to hit it over the on side but the ball turns away and takes the top edge. The ball skies towards cover and Shafiul Ismal comes sprinting in from the deep, gets into the position but in the end spills it. A single is taken.
Draws Cummins forward and then turns it away to beat his willow's outside edge.

Cummins punches it towards extra cover where the fielder dives to make a good stop.
Shakib with a round-arm action, fires it outside off, from around the wicket. Agar hits it towards long on and takes the single.
Slower one around middle and leg, defended by prodding ahead.
Flatter again on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Strides across and plays it towards the point fielder.
Once again bowls a flatter ball outside off, Pat shoulders arms to let that one through.
Leans across and pushes it with an angled bat towards point.
Flatter outside off, left alone without much fuss.

FOUR BYES! Taijul tosses it up outside off, it turns away with sharp bounce. Cummins looks to drive but gets beaten all ends up. The man at first slip sticks his left hand out to stop it but the ball goes past him races away towards the third man fence.
Keeps his bat in front of the pads and nudges it towards short leg.
Shakib goes around the wicket and fires it across the southpaw who looks to poke at it but is beaten all ends up.
Leans forward to defend but gets it off the inner half towards short leg.
Stays a bit low but it's sprayed outside off which makes the task easy for Agar to defend.
Tosses it up on off, Ashton lunges forward in defense.
A bit short and spinning in from outside off, Agar defends it off the back foot.
Goes around the wicket and loops it full outside off. Defended by keeping a straight bat.
Darts it in from around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Sends it quicker and flatter outside off, Agar goes chasing after it only to get beaten.
Too full on off, Agar drives it on the bounce back to Islam.
Sharp turn! Spins back in heavily and Agar misses his attempted drive. The ball goes off the pads and lobs towards the vacant silly point region.
Sprays it on off, wristed towards the man at mid-wicket.
Taijul Islam is brought back for a bowl.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Ashton has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

On middle and leg, tucked towards the right of the short leg fielder.
Pitches it around leg, Cummins comes half forward and offers no stroke.
Darts it wide outside off, Cummins dinks it down to long off for a single.
That's not impressive from Shakib. He's got a slip, a silly point and a gully placed but fires this full on leg. Easily clipped away towards square leg.
Darts it on middle, defended down watchfully into the ground.
Goes back and pushes this loopy delivery into the cover region for a single.
Flattish on off, punched down towards long off for a single.
Edged but safe! Loops it up outside off, Cummins with soft hands looks to defend it down but gets an outside edge which rolls safely towards second slip.
Slower through the air outside off, Pat looks to pat it with soft hands but gets a safe outside edge which rolls towards backward point for one.
This one spins back in on middle and leg, Cummins misses his defense and gets hit on the pads.
Steps out of the crease and eases the drive towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, Cummins makes room to drive but the ball dips in, takes the inside edge and rolls behind square on the leg side for a single.
Keeps his bat and pad together to defend.
Floats it up on the stumps, Cummins blocks it off the front foot.
AA has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushes it slower through the air outside off, defended with an angled bat towards point.
Spinning back in, but the length is short which allows Cummins to flick it away towards square leg and run one.
Stump to stump line, Cummins does well to keep that one out off the front foot.
Slows it through the air outside off, Cummins leans ahead to defend.
Outside off, turning in and stays really low. Agar manages to flick it away through square leg for a single.
Drops it a bit short on middle, tucked through the leg side for one.
Too full on off, Agar lunges forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Looks to come forward at first but then stays back to keep it out.
Drifting in from around off, Ashton once again is solid in defense.
Flat and outside off, punched it towards cover.
Quicker through the air around off, Agar defends it by prodding forward.
Tossed up outside off, blocked gently.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Serves it outside the off stump, no trouble for batsman.
Loops it up on off, Cummins comes nicely forward to keep it out.
Gets forward and defends it down.

OUT! Stumped! Smart bowling from Shakib this. He sees Maxwell wearing his dancing shoes and wisely pulls his length back and loops it on off. Poor Glenn tries his best to defend but misses it altogether due to the sharp away spin. Rahim behind the stumps whips the bails off and that's the end of Maxwell. Australia still trail by 116 runs.
Quicker delivery outside off, Agar has got nothing to do with that one.
Allows the ball to come back in from outside off and defends it back to the bowler.
Skips down the track and eases it towards mid off. Tamim dives to his right to keep them down to a single.
Once again brings his bat and pad together to keep it out.
Takes a good stride forward and kills it down on the pitch.
Drifting in on middle, Maxwell goes back and works it towards the man at 45.
Darts in full on the stumps, bunted back to Shakib.
Outside off, Glenn punches it towards the cover region for a single.
Wooah! Pitched outside off and it turns away massively. Left alone from Maxi as he stands there and gives it a gawk.
FOUR! Nailed it! Tossed up outside off, Maxwell gets down on one knee, fetches it from outside off and sweeps it off the middle of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flat and wide outside off, Maxwell lets it be.
Maxwell once again shimmies down the track and defends it with his pad and bat close together.
Lands safely! More air from Mehedi and Agar decides to go after it. Mistimes it high in the air towards long off as the ball lands down safely. They run two before the fielder mops it up.
Flighted delivery on off, driven on the up towards short extra cover.
Drifting in on middle, Glenn works it past short leg for a single.
Goes back and tucks it with the spin towards FSL.
Comes down the track and pushes it awkwardly back to Hasan.
Loopy delivery around middle, skidding in a bit, defended by keeping his bat and pad together.
Tossed up outside off, it turns in and cramps Agar for room. He manages to keep it out back to the bowler.
Looks to come forward but then goes back and defends it on the wicket.
Steps forward and kills it into the pitch.
A bit flatter outside off, punched off the back foot by Ashton.
Floats it up outside off, Agar prods forward in defense.
Full on off, driven into the cover region.
Stays back in the crease and works with the angle towards square leg.
Spinning down the leg side, Maxwell shoulders his arms.
In his quest to give it a bit more flight, Mehedi overpitches it a touch. Easy for the batsman who drives it through covers for a couple.
Once again decides to flight it around off, Maxwell jams it out.
FOUR! Good one from Maxi! Sees the flight, dances down to the pitch of the ball and hits it through mid off to pick up a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.

Stumping chance missed! Agar dances down the track to flick it away but the ball straightens up a touch, bounces a bit more as Agar misses it completely. Rahim behind the stumps fails to collect it and the ball goes through him to the fence.
Slider on the stumps, stays really low as Maxwell adjusts well to clip it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Maxwell leans ahead and defends it into the ground.
Loopy ball on middle and off, blocked from within the crease.
Around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Ashton Agar is the new man in. Meanwhile, Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end.

OUT! Early success for Bangladesh! It's Mehedi Hasan who strikes almost instantly. From around the wicket, he floats it up around off, it drifts in as Wade lunges forward to defend. The ball sneaks through and pings him on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal from Hasan and umpire Nigel Llong raises his dreaded finger. Wade walks towards Maxwell and has a long chat and finally decides to walk off. Oh no, he should have reviewed this. Ball Tracker shows that it's in line but would have gone on to miss the stumps. Lucky breakthrough for the hosts and Australia slip further.
Quicker one from around middle and leg, defended off the back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Matthew drives it along the ground towards short extra cover.
Gives it a nice air and bowls it full on middle and off, Wade keeps his bat face open and defends it towards cover.
From around the wicket to the southpaw. Darts in a full ball on middle and leg. Defended by lunging forward.
Begins the spell with a loopy full ball around off, a soft hand push from Maxwell towards mid off and they cross for a quick single.
We are back for the afternoon session. Will the hosts wrap it up quickly? Or will the current pair show some resistance? We shall find out. It shall be Glenn Maxwell up against Mehedi Hasan.
... Day 2, session 2...

Australia are still 137 runs behind and have 4 wickets in hand. Maxwell and Wade are out there and one would feel the former should start to counter-attack and reduce the deficit to as low as possible. Considering the nature of the wicket, any lead close to 100 would be an icing on the cake for the Tigers. Another intriguing session awaits. Do join us shortly to catch all the action from the second session...

This session - 27 overs, 105 runs and 3 wickets! That's the session summary. Bangladesh came out with intent and removed Steven Smith very early this morning. All was rosy for the hosts but the young pair of Renshaw and Handscomb decided to dig in out there and did not let the opposition run away with the game. They showed good technique and then started to keep the scoreboard ticking. It was Taijul Islam who broke the vital 69-run stand and just when the lunch break was approaching, Shakib Al Hasan struck gold as he sent the set Aussie opener, Renshaw packing.
Another quicker delivery, outside off, the ball stays low. Wade fails to put bat on ball this time. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!
FOUR! Good shot! Quicker around off, Wade hangs back and punches it beautifully through the point region for a boundary.
Shorter around off, Maxwell camps back and whips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, swept towards deep mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Wade gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Matthew Wade walks in next.

OUT! World No.1 all-rounder for a reason! Rahim gets his strike bowler into the attack and he does not disappoint. Floats this one outside off and holds its line, Renshaw stays in his crease and hangs his bat out in defence. Ends up outside edging it and the ball flies towards Sarkar at first slip who misjudges it at first. But holds onto it in the second attempt. Shakib celebrates by spreading his arms wide. Matt will be disappointed as he had done all the hard work till now and he just missed out on his fifty by mere five runs. A gritty knock comes to an end.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl an over before lunch. Can he strike?
FOUR! Boom! Shorter around off, Maxwell camps back and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Maxwell gets forward to defend. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball rolls past the slip fielder for a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Maxwell stays deep in his crease and blocks it away.
Clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

Wait, what! Is that dropped? No! Way wide outside off, Renshaw shuffles across and lets that through. The keeper gets a glove on it and the ball hits Sarkar's shoulder on its way past him. The batsmen run two and the umpire signals runs. For a moment even we thought that there was bat involved but replays confirmed that Matt's bat was way too far for contact.
Fuller delivery outside off, Maxwell prods forward and pushes it on the off side.
Fuller around leg, Glenn gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Five Wides! Short delivery into the batsman, Maxwell ducks underneath it. The ball keeps on rising and the ball goes over the keeper for a boundary. The umpire also signals it as a wide.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Angles this one down the leg side, Maxwell is undisturbed at the crease.
Good length delivery outside off, Maxwell lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, Maxwell gets forward to push but only manages to chop.
Fuller around off, Matt prods forward and dead bats it.
Angles this is quicker into the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Maxwell gets forward and defends it away from the body. That's something risky.
Glenn Maxwell strides out to bat.

OUT! That's plumb! Taijul Islam provides the much-needed breakthrough. He fires this quicker in line of the stumps, Handscomb camps back and that's the mistake he commits. His back foot movement makes him delay the clip which he misses. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal long and hard. The umpire thinks a bit and raises his dreaded finger. Handscomb has to make the long way back. The 69-run stand comes to an end, Australia still trail by 158 runs.
Around off, Renshaw waits for it and reverse sweeps it towards third man for a single.
Floated outside off, Renshaw lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Peter again shuffles to the length delivery and defends it on the leg side.
Another disguised slower one on a fuller length, Handscomb shuffles across and defends it really late.
Back of a length delivery around off, Matt stays in his crease and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Waste of a delivery! Way, way, way outside off. Renshaw will need a really big bat to reach out for it.
This time the ball kicks off the deck! Length delivery outside off, rises a bit too high. Renshaw shoulders his arms to it.
On a length and outside off, the ball keeps a touch low as Renshaw fails to defend it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Renshaw shuffles across and clips it towards square leg for a single. 100 up for Australia.
Renshaw, this time, lunges forward and gets his bat down in time to defend it.

Quicker outside off, Renshaw prods forward in defence. Fails to get bat to it and the ball hits the pads and flies towards the slip fielder. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. The impact was well outside the off stump line and hence the decision.
Floated around off, Matt goes for the unorthodox reverse sweep. Misses it completely and the ball kisses the pads and goes past the keeper. The batsmen run a couple of leg byes there.

Spinning in from outside off, Matt Renshaw shuffles across and flicks it straight towards the fielder at short leg. Again ends up hitting Imrul Kayes on his left thigh. That's really tough for any fielder as he is literally getting bullets fired at him.
Fuller delivery outside off, Handscomb gets forward and defends it off the outer half.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bye! Length delivery outside off, Renshaw lets it through. The balls bounces in front of Rahim who gets an awkward bounce. He fails to stop it and the ball rolls away towards fine leg for a single.

Too harsh to call that a drop! Fuller around off, Renshaw stays in his crease and clips it on the leg side. The ball flies towards the fielder at short leg. Kayes, the fielder there, has hardly anytime to react as he gets hit on his left thigh. A bit to his right and it would have been a chance.
Back of a length delivery, nips in a bit. Renshaw, at first hangs his bat in defence but drops his wrists at the last moment.
Length delivery, angling into the batsman. Renshaw defends it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Handscomb joins the party! Tossed up around off, Peter this time reaches out to it and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Costly over this.
Leg bye! Quicker delivery around off, Renshaw goes to play the sweep. Misses again and wears it on the pads. The batsmen run a leg bye as the ball goes past the keeper.
FOUR! Good attacking batting! Floated in line of the stumps, Renshaw kneels down and sweeps it brilliantly over the square leg region for a boundary.
Nudged through the backward square leg region for a single.
Renshaw clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.

Shout for LBW! Spinning in from outside off, Renshaw kneels and tries to sweep it. Misses it completely and gets rapped on the pads. The ball nearly rolls onto the stumps. Meanwhile, Taijul Islam appeals his heart out but the umpire is not interested as the impact was outside off.
Around off on a length, PH stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
That's a slower delivery on a very full length in line of the stumps, Handscomb defends it neatly.
Comes around the wicket this time, hurls this on a fuller length on off. Peter defends it neatly.
Comes steaming in and bowls this one fuller outside off, Handscomb gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Slower delivery around off on a fuller length, Renshaw gets his bat down in time. Squirts it off the inside edge through the backward square leg region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Renshaw thinks of poking at it at first but decides either wise.
Floated around off, Handscomb lunges forward and defends it.
Tossed up around off, Peter camps back and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Shorter around off, pushed towards the fielder at point.
Handscomb gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Shorter around off, kicks and turns in off the deck. Renshaw tries to defend it but gets surprised by the bounce. Is hit on the glove and the ball lobs just wide of the fielder at short leg. A single is taken. This is the highest 5th-wicket stand for Australia in Bangladesh.
Quicker outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Good length delivery into the hips, Peter stands in his crease and blocks it down. Maiden to start with for the Fizz.
Good length delivery outside off, Handscomb punches it towards the fielder at mid off.
Again hurls this outside off, Handscomb directs his bat skywards.
Way outside off this time, PH is never going to play at those.
Good length delivery outside off, Peter stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Angles it across the batsman from a length outside off, Handscomb shoulders his arms to it.
Finally Mustafizur Rahman is introduced into the attack.
Drinks are on the field.

50-run stand between Renshaw and Handscomb. These two have dug in quite well after the departure of their skipper early on. They have survived a few scares but that has not let them down from milking the singles. They need to carry on just like Tamim and Shakib did for their side.
Drifting in on leg stump, nicely clipped away towards deep square leg for a single.
Pitched right up there, it's defended into the ground.
Loops it up outside off, Peter stonewalls it.
Around middle and leg, Renshaw gets a long way across to clip it fine down the leg side. It was racing away but the fielder in the deep does well to stop it. Three runs taken.
Around off, spinning in, tucked towards short leg.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Taijul starts off with a loosener first up. Goes too full and sprays it wide outside off, Renshaw leans ahead and drives it through covers. No need to run for those.
Change in bowling now. Taijul Islam is brought in to roll his arm over. Two men in the deep on the leg side for Renshaw.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off, Renshaw chops it down off the back foot. The ball goes on the bounce to Sarkar at first slip.
Flatter one on middle, punched off the back foot back to the bowler.
Hangs deep in the crease and clips it through square leg for a single.
Slides it on middle and leg, a bit on the shorter side which gives Handscomb enough time to tuck it away towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Massive turn and bounce! Can't blame Rahim for that! Spinning viciously down leg with healthy bounce. Handscomb moves inside the line and then lifts his bat to pick up two byes for his side.
Tossed up outside off, defended gently into the ground.
Goes back, allows the ball to turn in and then clips it behind square on the leg side to keep strike.
PH has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Swept away nicely! Shakib tosses it up around off, it spins in as Handscomb gets down on one knee to sweep it in front of square leg. Another boundary in the over and this shot is coming out well for Peter.
Stays on the back foot to dab it away towards first slip. All soft hands.
Drags his length back a touch and turns it away to beat the forward defense of Peter.
FOUR! Tonk! Handscomb gets down on one knee and gives it a full swing of his bat. Makes a terrific connection and picks up a boundary towards deep mid-wicket.
Slower through the air outside off, pushed away with an angled bat towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

A loud shout for an LBW! Lands it around middle, it slides off the deck. Renshaw presses forward to defend but misses only to be rapped on the pads. Mehedi appeals but the umpire turns it down. The youngster looks at his skipper and asks for the review but the latter pays no interest. Replays show it would have clipped the leg stump. So, the umpire's call would have stayed.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off, Matt Renshaw makes an easy leave.
Loops it up outside off, Renshaw prods forward in defense.
Slower through the air outside off, MR shoulders his arms to that one.
Brendon Julian on-air mentions that Matt Renshaw had a really good tour in India which would have given him the confidence to tackle the spinners here.
FOUR! Swept away! Around middle and leg, Handscomb sinks low and brooms it through backward square leg for a boundary. Safe shot against the spinners.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Gets forward and pats it towards cover for a single.
Drops it a bit short around middle, the ball turns back in and cramps Renshaw for room who somehow defends it towards short leg.
Lands it on a length around middle and leg, the batsman works it off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
A bit too full around off, Renshaw shows good front foot defense.
Tossed up delivery on middle, gripping in, Handscomb inside edges this towards short leg. Luckily for him, it bounced before going into the fielder's hands.
Goes back and flicks it towards the leg side once again.
Tossed up on off, spinning back in, worked with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Stays rooted inside the crease to jam this one out.
Flatter through the air, around off, defended from within the crease.
Bowls a slider around middle, Handscomb goes leg side to flick it away but misses and is struck on the pads. Bangladesh appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Turning from a length outside off, Matt looks to defend but gets it off the outer half towards the left of the slip fielder.
Makes some room and eases it towards cover. Still can't find the gap.
Loopy outside off, nicely pushed away towards the cover region.

FOUR! Edged but falls short! A bit flatter and served outside off, Renshaw has a poke at it. It's enough to induce an outside edge but falls short of Sarkar at first slip and rolls further away for a streaky boundary.
Floats it up around off, Matt presses forward to keep it out.
Gets right behind the line and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another good stop from Taijul! Handscomb flicks it away towards backward square leg and it's another brilliant diving stop from the fielder to stop some runs.
Excellent stop, Taijul Islam! Hasan drops it short on leg, Peter goes back to pull but Islam stationed at backward square leg dives to his left to stop a certain boundary.
FOUR! Hasan looks to toss it up around off, but it's a bit too full. Handscomb leans forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary. Good shot! 50 comes up for Australia.
Makes a bit of room to cut it away but ends up getting an inside edge on the pads.
Around middle, turning in, clipped off the back foot towards short fine leg.
Crouches low and blocks this quick delivery in front of silly point.
Spinning down the leg side, Renshaw tries clipping it away but fails to do so. The umpire thinks Renshaw didn't attempt any shot and hence signals it as a dead ball.
Beaten! Floats it up outside off, Matt Renshaw comes forward to defend but the ball skids off the deck and nearly takes the outside edge.
FOUR! Nicely dabbed! Shakib bowls a tossed up delivery but drops it a bit short, Renshaw stays back and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to steer it past first slip for a boundary.
Floats it up outside off, Renshaw buries it into the ground.
Lunges forward and blocks it into the ground.
A bit flat and outside off, defended off the back foot.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Peter camps back and tucks it towards square leg.
Flicked with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and served outside off, Matt tries to cut but then pulls out of the shot. Nicely collected by Rahim.

NOT OUT! A successful review from Australia! Matt Renshaw looks a relieved man. Mehedi Hasan tosses it up around middle and off, Renshaw takes a big stride forward to defend but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards silly point. They appeal but not that convincingly. But umpire Aleem Dar raises his finger. Renshaw isn't happy with the decision and hence challenges it. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved and Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitched in line but would have gone on to miss the stumps. So much bounce? Still can't believe it. Nonetheless, a good use of the review from the visitors.
Umpire Aleem Dar raises the finger after a stifled appeal. Matt Renshaw is not happy and takes the review.
Mehedi gives it a nice loop and lands it around off, Renshaw takes a stride forward to keep it out.
Loopy full ball outside off, another solid front foot defense from Peter.
Flatter around middle and off, Peter goes back in the crease and defends.
Leans forward and blocks it down gently.

NOT OUT! Bangladesh waste a review! It's missing the stumps. Spot on from umpire Nigel Llong says the commentator on air. Shakib serves a slider around middle, it skids off the deck and hits Handscomb low on the pads who misses his attempted flick shot. A loud shout for an LBW has been turned down. Shakib is so confident that he convinces his skipper to take the DRS. Replays show it's in line but would have gone on to miss the stumps. Handscomb survives a scare here.
Shakib is very confident there and he convinces his skipper to go for an LBW review against Peter Handscomb!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Peter stonewalls it.
Spin from both ends now. Shakib Al Hasan comes on to bowl.
Slider around middle and leg, flicked with the angle towards mid-wicket for a single.
Edged and away! Tossed up wider outside off, Handscomb comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls wide of first slip. They come back for a couple.
Confusion in the middle. Handscomb clips it towards mid-wicket. There is some confusion in the middle as Nasir misfields but they decide not to run.
Goes back and does well to wrist it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, defended by lunging forward.
Around middle and leg, worked with the spin through square leg for a single.
Angling in on middle and leg, Handscomb nudges it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, Peter stands back to defend it down.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked towards the leg side.
After that boundary, there is a deep point for Handscomb...
FOUR! Cracking shot! On a back of a length outside off, Handscomb stays back and cuts it beautifully through point to find the fence to get off the mark.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, Renshaw flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Peter Handscomb is the next man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! That's a big, big wicket for Bangladesh. Steven Smith is out of here. Mehedi Hasan sees Smith giving the charge and hence nicely loops it up around middle. The Aussie skipper tries to work it away on the leg side but instead yorks himself. The ball hits the surface, grips and turns in to beat the batsman. It then goes on to clip the top of leg stump. That's a hammer blow for the Aussies, says Brendon Julian on air. It is indeed. Bangladesh are elated.
Flicked towards the man at square leg.
Tries to dart but ends up bowling a full toss on the pads. Renshaw flicks it through mid-wicket. They run three this time.
Goes back to this flatter ball and works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Drifting on the pads, Matt misses it completely. The ball again lobs towards Sabbir at short leg.

A shout for bat-pad! Tossed up delivery, sliding around middle and leg. Renshaw comes forward to defend but misses as the ball lobs off something towards Sabbir Rahman at short leg who fumbles but takes the catch in the second attempt. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Replays show the ball went off the pads.
Once again pitches it a bit fuller outside off, Steven defends it towards cover.
A bit fuller outside off, Smith presses forward in defense.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out off the back foot.
On a length and around off, Smith decides to defend it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge on the pads.
On a length and outside off, Smith stays back and pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Islam starts off with a juicy half-volley, outside off. Steven Smith lunges ahead and creams the drive through covers to pick up the first boundary of the day.
Surprise, surprise! Shafiul Islam to bowl from the other end.
Lands it outside off, it doesn't rise at all. Easily left alone.
Lunges ahead and clips it towards mid on.

A loud cry for an LBW! Nicely slows it through the air around off, it straightens up a touch and pings Renshaw on the back pad. Hasan appeals but umpire Aleem Dar calms him down. The impact was outside the line. This bloke is so energetic when he appeals.

FOUR BYES! Slides it down the leg side, Matt Renshaw tries flicking it away but fails to do so. Rahim behind the stumps was blinded by the batsman and hence had no chance to stop it from running away into the fine leg fence.
Sees Smith dancing down the track, so fires it full down the leg side. The Aussie skipper manages to help it away through square leg for a single.
Mehedi starts off with a full ball around the pads, Renshaw gets forward and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single. First run of the day for Australia.

It's time to get underway then. The overnight batsmen make their way out to the middle along with the Bangladesh players. Mehedi Hasan to bowl first up to Matt Renshaw. A slip, short leg and a silly point in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan doing the pitch report says the rough is opening up. Adds apart from the spinners, Mustafizur Rahman would be the key for Bangladesh. Further says if he can pitch the ball in the right areas, it will become all too difficult for the batsmen. Ends by saying, yesterday it was tough, today and for the days to come it will only get tougher.

Remember, Steven Smith scored a classic ton against India in Pune earlier this year on a similar kind of wicket and he would look to replicate something like that again. The hosts would be all charged up and raring to go in with the crowd right behind them. An important update - the weather looks awesome to kick off proceedings for the day and let's hope it remains the same throughout. Stay tuned as the action isn't far away.

Hello and a warm welcome for day 2 of this first Test between Bangladesh and Australia. The hosts have a firm grip on this match as they have scalped 3 quick wickets to dent the momentum that the Aussies had after the first innings. With the pitch expected to deteriorate further, it's safe to say that the Aussies have their task cut out. A lot of hopes shall be pinned on skipper Smith if they are to evade from this situation.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Renshaw and Smith are out in the middle and it will require a huge effort from these two to bail their side out of the early trouble. The hosts are sitting pretty on top and their spinners would be licking their lips to go out and deliver. The only worry is about the weather which doesn't look promising for the days to come. Let's hope it holds up and we get to witness a great encounter between these two sides. Join us tomorrow at 1000 local (0400 GMT) to catch all the action, saying again, weather permitting. Until then, it's goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Phew! What a session it turned out to be. Bangladesh have come out roaring with the cherry and have posed a serious threat to the mighty Aussies. After getting bundled out for 260, courtesy a massive 155-run stand between Tamim and Shakib, they have not let the visitors settle down. Rahim didn't waste anytime in bringing his spinners on, on a wicket that is turning, bouncing, staying low and causing all sorts of trouble for the batsmen. Mehedi Hasan was the first one to take the wicket and after that it seemed like a procession. Khawaja was dismissed via an unnecessary run out while nightwatchman, Nathan Lyon couldn't do the job he was sent for.
Quicker one fired around the pads, flicked past mid-wicket for a couple to end the day. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Drops it a bit short and outside off, Smith punches it towards extra cover.
Flighted full delivery on off, Steven bunts it back to the bowler.
Bowls it down the leg side, Smith looks to help it away but fails to do so.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Lunges forward and defends it into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Renshaw takes a stride forward and pads it away. He's offered no stroke but it was clearly pitching outside leg. A stifled appeal is denied.
Gets across and works it towards mid on for a single.
Darting in from around middle, Renshaw looks to defend but the ball squirts off the inner edge past fine leg. A single is taken.
Flatter outside off, Renshaw defends it off the back foot.
Fuller around off, defended by coming froward.
Skipper Steven Smith walks out next.

OUT! The Nightwatchman departs as well. Shakib drifts it from around middle, Lyon takes a stride forward to defend but he plays that one down the wrong line. Is hit on the pads and the umpire has no harm in raising his finger to an LBW appeal. Lyon doesn't even wait, just walks off. Bangladesh are on a roll here.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires it full and outside off, it's left alone.
Drifting in from around middle, Lyon misses it and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal is turned down.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Nathan Lyon is making his way out in the middle.

OUT! Run Out! The Bangla crowd is screaming at the top of their voices! This is a real waste of a wicket. Shakib floats it up around off, Khawaja comes forward to defend but the ball goes off the gloves through the vacant silly point region. Usman sets off for a run without even looking at his partner. Rahim charges towards the ball and now Renshaw sends him back. The former throws the ball at the stumps at his end where Soumya Sarkar collects the ball, dives and manages to dislodge the bails in the second attempt as Khawaja puts in a dive. They appeal and it's taken upstairs. Replays find Khawaja short of his ground. Australia in trouble.
There is complete drama here in the middle. The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Usman Khawaja. Will his dive save him?
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and wide outside off, Renshaw goes back and slaps it through point for a boundary to end to what has been an eventful over.
Another loud appeal! Slider around middle and leg, Renshaw misses his flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal but this time it was going down leg.
Darts it in from around middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
Usman Khawaja will bat at number 3!

OUT! Gone next ball! Warner can't believe as he stands there in disappointment. He doesn't take the review this time and starts to walk back. A flatter delivery, sliding in, David Warner goes back to defend but misses and wears it on the back pad. Once again a loud appeal and once again it's ruled out by the umpire. Replays confirm there was no bat involved and the Ball Tracker shows it's in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. So, the umpire's call stays. Mehedi Hasan draws first blood.

NOT OUT! David Warner is confident as he opts for the review almost instantly. A slider around middle, Warner comes forward to defend as he was playing for the spin but the ball skids on with the arm and hits him on the pads. A loud appeal to which Umpire Aleem Dar raises his finger. Warner isn't happy and challenges the on-field call. Replays show there was a clear inside edge there.
Warner is given out LBW! But he is very quick to review it. Seems pretty confident.
Gives it a nice flight outside off, David pushes it towards cover.
Brings his bat close to the pads and defends it down watchfully.
Floats it up outside off, Renshaw covers the line and keeps it out.
Keeps his bat face open and dabs it towards backward point.
A bit too full this time, it's jammed out back to Shakib.
Fuller on off, patted through covers for a single.

A loud shout for a caught behind! Shakib tosses it up outside off, Warner pays no interest as he gets down to play the reverse sweep. The ball goes off something towards the man at first slip and the Bangladesh fielders go up in unison. The umpire shakes his head. Replays show it went off the thigh pad. But Warner should be careful here as the day is about to end.
Spin from both ends now. Bangladesh are on the charge as they bring in Shakib Al Hasan into the attack.
This one didn't rise at all. Fuller outside off, it stays really, really low. Renshaw looks to defend but gets a bottom edge towards Rahim as the ball ricochets onto the stumps.
Flighted delivery outside off, Renshaw gets down and buries it into the ground.
Floats it up outside off, defended into the ground.
Gives it nice revs and lands it outside off, Matt Renshaw presses forward and dabs it wide of silly point.
Takes a stride forward and blocks this tossed up ball towards the leg side.
Drifting in from around off, Renshaw lunges forward to defend but gets it off the inner half past short leg.
Fuller delivery outside off, Warner lunges forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
Angling across from a good length outside off, Warner shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery around leg, Warner gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Short outside off, Warner shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Warner drives it back towards the bowler. Shafiul Islam hurls a throw at the striker's end but David is well inside the line.
Fuller around off, Warner defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller into the pads, Renshaw gets forward and defends it.
Big turn here! Tosses it outside off, Renshaw gets forward to defend but chooses to leave it at the last moment as it is spinning sharply away.
Floated around off, Matt gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Quicker around off, Renshaw shoulders his arms to it.
Floated outside off, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Floated outside off, Renshaw shoulders his arms to it.
Mehedi Hasan to share the new ball with Shafiul Islam.
Length delivery around off, Warner pushes hard at it. Gets an outside edge towards the backward point region.
Length delivery around leg, Warner tries to defend it. Gets beaten and is hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Replays show that there was an inside edge.
FOUR! Don't waste time says Warner! Short and wide outside off, David slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Fuller delivery around off, Renshaw guides it through the gully region for a single.
Great line! Bowls this around off, straightens a touch. Renshaw shuffles across to defend only to get beaten.
Hurls this one in the line of the pads, Warner is off the mark as he clips it towards fine leg for a single.
